adjudicated.jp: 「今の冬子のオバサン度は９２％だ。平均が２５％だから致命的だな。しかも加齢とともに１％ずつ増えていくから、おまえ三十路のずっと手前で完膚無きまでにオバサン完全体になるな」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Currently your old bag level is 92%, Touko. Being that the average is 25%, it is therefore lethal. Furthermore, as with every year of age accumulated it grows by 1%, you will, before you hit age 30, become thoroughly and perfectly an old bag in body and soul."
comments: 92% = Touko's Conformity Coefficient (46%) times 2, see CCC3021. Difference is sixtySEVEN percent. With the progress, she'd hit 100% in 8 years, at 29 eroge years (25 real years). Interesting he'd double her CC, given how I suspect Alter Egos share CC and therefore Taichi's is double due to Youko not existing. -GHS
